method_baselines: exact Gaussian likelihood / GLS (tie by sufficiency, R53)

scoring.LOSS: competitor is tighter or better calibrated on the same data
scoring.NOT_COMPARABLE: different data or model class; say so
scoring.TIE: same information; differences within stated uncertainty (expected for any sufficient-statistic comparison)
scoring.WIN: HTT statement is calibrated where the competitor's is not, or reaches a tighter calibrated bound on the same data and assumptions
scoring.rule: a TIE is never reported as a WIN; a WIN needs the competitor replicated first
